scenarios.name: valid_zipcode_returns_200
scenarios.description: A valid 8-digit zip code returns HTTP 200 with address fields
scenarios.expected_behavior: Response contains logradouro, bairro, localidade, uf

scenarios.name: invalid_zipcode_returns_error
scenarios.description: An invalid zip code format returns HTTP 400 or error body

scenarios.name: non_numeric_zipcode_returns_400
scenarios.description: Non-numeric zip code input returns HTTP 400
scenarios.expected_behavior: API rejects non-numeric input with status 400

scenarios.name: short_zipcode_returns_400
scenarios.description: A zip code with fewer than 8 digits returns 400

scenarios.name: response_has_required_fields
scenarios.description: Valid response includes all required address fields
scenarios.expected_behavior: Fields cep, logradouro, complemento, bairro, localidade, uf, ibge are present
